_comment: Decoded Apple identity token payloads (claims only, no real signatures). Tests that need a signed JWT sign these payloads with a test RS256 key and serve the matching public key as the JWKS. Values are mock; sub, emails and ids are invented.
_usage: Use in tests of token verification, user resolution, relay email handling and nonce binding. Every payload's `nonce` is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of raw_nonce unless stated otherwise. Timestamps are fixed; tests freeze the clock at 1700000100.
_provenance: Claim names, issuer, boolean-or-string flags and the nonce encoding are from Apple documentation as the block author knows it (MEDIUM, confirm). Not captured from a real Apple response.

native_valid_with_email._comment: New or returning iOS user with a real email. aud is the iOS bundle id.

native_valid_private_relay_string_flags._comment: User chose to hide their email. Flags arrive as the string "true" here to cover Apple's boolean-or-string behavior.

native_valid_no_email._comment: No email claim at all. The user is created with email, name and domain null.

web_valid._comment: Web flow token. aud is the Services ID.

collision_email_of_google_user._comment: Valid token whose email equals an existing Google-only user (alice@example.com). Expect 409 account_exists_with_different_provider.

invalid_wrong_audience._comment: Valid signature, token issued for a different app. Expect 401 apple_auth_failed.

invalid_wrong_issuer._comment: Issuer is not Apple. Expect 401 apple_auth_failed.

invalid_expired._comment: exp is before the frozen clock (1700000100) by more than the 5 s skew. Expect 401 apple_auth_failed.

invalid_email_not_verified._comment: Email present but email_verified is false. Expect 401 apple_auth_failed.

invalid_nonce_mismatch._comment: nonce claim is the digest of "nonce-aaa"; send raw_nonce "nonce-bbb". Expect 401 apple_auth_failed.

jwt_headers._comment: Header variants to sign with. Only the first must verify.
